## Constitution Check

- [ ] I. Showcase-First: content stays in `content/`, no layout change needed for content edits
- [ ] II. Performance: landing JS <= 150 KB compressed, Lighthouse >= 95, no regression > 5 points
- [ ] III. Accessibility: axe reports zero serious/critical, keyboard operable, AA contrast in both themes
- [ ] IV. Motion: purposeful, reduced-motion honoured, transform/opacity only, tokens used
- [ ] V. Quality gates: tests written first for logic, e2e updated, snapshots reviewed, CI green
